effect.name: Glow
effect.description: A soft halo around the sprite's silhouette, drawn behind it. Unlike Bloom this does not care how bright the sprite is - a pitch black sprite still glows - so it works for magic, pickups and selection states.
effect.author: CyberMushroom

parameter.name: Glow Colour
parameter.description: Colour of the halo. Default is DMG 155,188,15.

parameter.name: Radius
parameter.description: How far the halo reaches, in texels.

parameter.name: Falloff
parameter.description: Above 1 the halo hugs the sprite, below 1 it spreads out flat.
